meta.project: AkreChain: Sistem Akreditasi Berbasis Blockchain dengan Integrasi AI untuk Automated Assessment (LAM-TEK 2025)

product_overview: AkreChain is a backend platform for managing accreditation submissions, secure document handling, AI-assisted scoring, and blockchain-backed workflow traceability. It supports multi-role accreditation operations from UPPS submission through final decision release, with auditability, notifications, and role-based approvals.
core_goals: Provide secure, authenticated accreditation workflows for multiple roles using JWT and MSP-based identity.
Store document evidence with encrypted off-chain files and immutable on-chain hashes for traceability.
Automate initial accreditation scoring and completeness checks using AI for LAM-TEK 2025 criteria.
Enable assessor matching, assignment, acceptance, and assessment submission with role-based coordination.
Support AL scheduling, execution, verification, final decisioning, and certificate release.
Deliver public traceability and authenticated detail lookup for accreditation records.
Notify users in real time about workflow events and status changes.

features.name: Authentication & MSP Identity
features.description: Handles user registration, login, token refresh, password changes, current-user lookup, logout, and Fabric MSP credential management for blockchain identity.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid user details -> Receive 201 with registered user data -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT access token and refresh token -> GET /api/v1/auth/me with access token -> Receive 200 with authenticated user profile
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/v1/auth/refresh without valid refresh token -> Receive 401 or 400 token refresh failure
POST /api/v1/auth/change-password with valid current password and new password -> Receive 200 password updated -> POST /api/v1/auth/logout with access token -> Receive 200 session invalidated

POST /api/v1/auth/msp with authenticated user -> Receive 201 with MSP credential created -> GET /api/v1/auth/msp with access token -> Receive 200 with MSP credential -> DELETE /api/v1/auth/msp with access token -> Receive 200 MSP credential deleted
GET /api/v1/auth/me without access token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/v1/auth/msp without access token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Submissions Management
features.description: Manages accreditation submission records, assignments, submission history, decision updates, and UPPS responses across the submission lifecycle.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/submissions with valid access token -> Receive 200 with submission list -> GET /api/v1/submissions/:id with valid token -> Receive 200 with submission detail -> PUT /api/v1/submissions/:id with updated fields -> Receive 200 with updated submission record

GET /api/v1/submissions/stats with valid access token -> Receive 200 with submission statistics -> GET /api/v1/submissions/:id/history with valid access token -> Receive 200 with blockchain/audit history

POST /api/v1/submissions/:id/assign with valid assessor payload -> Receive 200 with assessor assignment created -> POST /api/v1/submissions/:id/assign/accept with assigned assessor token -> Receive 200 assignment accepted -> POST /api/v1/submissions/:id/decision with valid decision payload -> Receive 200 decision recorded

POST /api/v1/submissions/:id/assign/reject with valid assessor token -> Receive 200 assignment rejected -> GET /api/v1/submissions/:id/assign with valid token -> Receive 200 with rejected assignment state

POST /api/v1/submissions/:id/upps-response with valid UPPS response -> Receive 200 with UPPS response recorded -> DELETE /api/v1/submissions/:id with authorized token -> Receive 200 submission deleted or marked removed

GET /api/v1/submissions/program-studi/:programStudi with valid token -> Receive 200 filtered submissions -> GET /api/v1/submissions/:id/assign without existing assignment -> Receive 404 or empty assignment state

features.name: Document Upload & Download
features.description: Supports secure document upload and retrieval for LED/LKPS files, along with metadata lookup and document information queries.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/upload with authenticated multipart LED or LKPS file -> Receive 201 with uploaded document ID and metadata -> GET /api/v1/upload/:id with access token -> Receive 200 with stored metadata -> GET /api/v1/download/:submissionId/:documentType with access token -> Receive 200 with document file stream

POST /api/v1/upload with file exceeding 50MB limit or unsupported format -> Receive 400 or 413 upload failure -> GET /api/v1/download/:submissionId/:documentType/info for missing document -> Receive 404 document info not found

GET /api/v1/download/:submissionId/:documentType/info with valid access token -> Receive 200 with document metadata and status -> GET /api/v1/download/:submissionId/:documentType with invalid submission or document type -> Receive 404 or 400 error response
POST /api/v1/upload without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: AI Scoring (LAM-TEK 7 Kriteria)
features.description: Runs Gemini-assisted scoring and manual override workflows for accreditation evaluation based on the 7 LAM-TEK criteria, including custom runs and result lookup.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/scoring/calculate with valid submission ID -> Receive 202 or 200 with scoring job accepted -> GET /api/v1/scoring/:id with valid access token -> Receive 200 with AI scoring result and recommendations

POST /api/v1/scoring/custom with valid submission and custom rules payload -> Receive 200 with custom scoring output -> POST /api/v1/scoring/manual with authorized manual override payload -> Receive 200 manual score saved

POST /api/v1/scoring/calculate for submission with missing documents or invalid ID -> Receive 400 or 404 scoring failure -> GET /api/v1/scoring/:id for unknown score ID -> Receive 404 result not found
GET /api/v1/scoring without authentication -> Receive 200 with public scoring list if enabled or 401 if protected, depending on deployment configuration

features.name: Assessors & Scholar Sync (RAG)
features.description: Provides assessor listing and scholar-data synchronization to enrich assessor profiles and support expertise-based matching and research area population.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/assessors with valid access token -> Receive 200 with assessor list -> GET /api/v1/assessors/:id with valid token -> Receive 200 with assessor profile details

POST /api/v1/assessors/sync-scholar with authorized token -> Receive 200 with Semantic Scholar sync results -> POST /api/v1/assessors/populate-research-areas with authorized token -> Receive 200 with research areas populated

POST /api/v1/assessors/sync-google-scholar with authorized token -> Receive 200 with Google Scholar sync results -> POST /api/v1/assessors/:id/sync-scholar with valid assessor ID -> Receive 200 with single-assessor sync result
POST /api/v1/assessors/sync-scholar with external service timeout or rate limit -> Receive 429 or 5xx sync failure -> GET /api/v1/assessors/:id for unknown assessor -> Receive 404 assessor not found

features.name: Asesor Assignment Workflow
features.description: Lets assessors view assignments, accept offers, respond to assignment requests, submit completed assessments, and review assignment history.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/asesor/assignments with assessor token -> Receive 200 with assignment list -> POST /api/v1/asesor/assignments/:id/accept with valid assignment -> Receive 200 assignment accepted -> POST /api/v1/asesor/assignments/:id/submit with completed assessment payload -> Receive 200 assessment submitted
POST /api/v1/asesor/respond-offer with accept response and notes -> Receive 200 offer response recorded -> GET /api/v1/asesor/history with assessor token -> Receive 200 with assessor history

POST /api/v1/asesor/assignments/:id/accept for an invalid or expired assignment -> Receive 400 or 404 acceptance failure -> POST /api/v1/asesor/respond-offer with reject response -> Receive 200 rejection recorded
GET /api/v1/asesor/assignments without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: KEA Assessor Coordination
features.description: Supports KEA operations for selecting assessors, assigning them to approved submissions, monitoring assessment consistency, and reviewing rejections.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/kea/submissions-approved with KEA token -> Receive 200 with approved submissions awaiting assessors -> GET /api/v1/kea/assessors with KEA token -> Receive 200 with assessor candidates -> POST /api/v1/kea/assign/:submissionId with selected assessor pair -> Receive 200 assignment created

GET /api/v1/kea/consistency with KEA token -> Receive 200 with scoring consistency overview -> GET /api/v1/kea/consistency/:submissionId/detail with KEA token -> Receive 200 with submission consistency detail -> POST /api/v1/kea/consistency/:submissionId with consistency decision -> Receive 200 decision saved
GET /api/v1/kea/pending-rejections with KEA token -> Receive 200 with pending rejections -> POST /api/v1/kea/review-rejection/:submissionId with review notes -> Receive 200 rejection reviewed

POST /api/v1/kea/assign/:submissionId with missing assessor pair or invalid submission -> Receive 400 or 404 assignment failure -> GET /api/v1/kea/monitoring with invalid role token -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Sekretariat & Payments
features.description: Covers secretariat submission verification, UPPS listing, payment invoice creation, payment verification, proof upload, and accreditation report access.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/sekretariat/submissions with secretariat token -> Receive 200 with submission queue -> POST /api/v1/sekretariat/verify/:submissionId with verification payload -> Receive 200 submission verified -> GET /api/v1/sekretariat/reports with secretariat token -> Receive 200 with accreditation reports

POST /api/v1/sekretariat/payments/invoice with valid payment data -> Receive 201 invoice created -> POST /api/v1/sekretariat/payments/:id/upload-proof with multipart proof file -> Receive 200 proof uploaded -> POST /api/v1/sekretariat/payments/:id/verify with verification payload -> Receive 200 payment verified

GET /api/v1/sekretariat/upps with secretariat token -> Receive 200 with UPPS directory -> GET /api/v1/sekretariat/payments/my with UPPS token -> Receive 200 with own payment records -> GET /api/v1/sekretariat/payments/check-status with authenticated token -> Receive 200 with payment status

POST /api/v1/sekretariat/payments/invoice with missing or invalid fields -> Receive 400 invoice creation failure -> POST /api/v1/sekretariat/payments/:id/verify for unknown payment -> Receive 404 payment not found
GET /api/v1/sekretariat/reports/download with secretariat token -> Receive 200 with report file -> GET /api/v1/sekretariat/submissions without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Delivers user notifications in real time via WebSocket and provides list, read, read-all, and delete operations through REST APIs.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/notifications with authenticated user -> Receive 200 with notification list -> PUT /api/v1/notifications/:id/read -> Receive 200 notification marked read -> PUT /api/v1/notifications/read-all -> Receive 200 all notifications marked read

WebSocket connection established through /api/v1/notifications or websocket route -> Receive realtime notification event -> GET /api/v1/notifications to confirm delivery -> Receive 200 updated notification list

DELETE /api/v1/notifications/:id with authenticated user -> Receive 200 notification deleted -> GET /api/v1/notifications/:id via list retrieval path not available -> Receive 404 if notification no longer exists
GET /api/v1/notifications without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: AL Schedule (Asesmen Lapangan)
features.description: Handles field-assessment scheduling, including pending and approved schedule lists, proposal, approval, letter generation, and blockchain sync checks.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/al-schedule/list/ready-for-al with authorized user -> Receive 200 with submissions ready for AL -> POST /api/v1/al-schedule/propose/:submissionId with date and venue -> Receive 200 AL schedule proposed -> GET /api/v1/al-schedule/:submissionId -> Receive 200 with proposed schedule details

GET /api/v1/al-schedule/list/pending with authorized user -> Receive 200 with pending schedules -> POST /api/v1/al-schedule/approve/:submissionId with approval payload -> Receive 200 AL schedule approved -> POST /api/v1/al-schedule/generate-letter/:submissionId -> Receive 200 assignment letter generated
POST /api/v1/al-schedule/check-sync/:submissionId with valid submission -> Receive 200 blockchain sync status -> GET /api/v1/al-schedule/list/approved -> Receive 200 approved schedules list

POST /api/v1/al-schedule/propose/:submissionId with invalid submission or malformed date/venue -> Receive 400 or 404 proposal failure -> POST /api/v1/al-schedule/approve/:submissionId without required authority -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: AL Execution
features.description: Records execution of field assessment and the UPPS response or clarification after AL, and allows retrieval of execution details.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/al-execution/:submissionId/execution with execution notes, BA CID, and scores -> Receive 200 execution recorded -> GET /api/v1/al-execution/:submissionId -> Receive 200 with AL execution detail -> POST /api/v1/al-execution/:submissionId/response with UPPS clarification -> Receive 200 response recorded

POST /api/v1/al-execution/:submissionId/execution for a submission not in AL-ready state -> Receive 400 or 409 execution rejected -> GET /api/v1/al-execution/:submissionId for unknown submission -> Receive 404 execution not found

features.name: Verification & Decision
features.description: Provides final verification and decision finalization for submissions after AL execution and responses are complete.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/verification/list/pending with authorized user -> Receive 200 with pending verification queue -> POST /api/v1/verification/:submissionId/verify with verification payload -> Receive 200 submission verified -> POST /api/v1/verification/:submissionId/finalize with final decision payload -> Receive 200 decision finalized
GET /api/v1/verification/list/decisions with authorized user -> Receive 200 with decisions list -> GET /api/v1/verification/list/decided -> Receive 200 with decided submissions

POST /api/v1/verification/:submissionId/verify for unknown or incomplete submission -> Receive 400, 404, or 409 verification failure -> POST /api/v1/verification/:submissionId/finalize without completed verification -> Receive 409 finalization blocked

features.name: Certificate Release
features.description: Lets authorized users preview certificates and publish accreditation certificates to the blockchain after final decision approval.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/release/list/ready with authorized user -> Receive 200 with submissions ready for certificate release -> GET /api/v1/release/:submissionId/preview-certificate -> Receive 200 with certificate preview -> POST /api/v1/release/:submissionId/publish -> Receive 200 certificate published to blockchain

POST /api/v1/release/:submissionId/publish for a submission not yet finalized -> Receive 409 or 400 publish rejected -> GET /api/v1/release/:submissionId/preview-certificate for unknown submission -> Receive 404 preview not found

features.name: Traceability & Public Search
features.description: Exposes public search and public blockchain history for accreditation records, and authenticated detail lookup for internal users.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/traceability/search without authentication -> Receive 200 with public accreditation search results -> GET /api/v1/traceability/history/:submissionId without authentication -> Receive 200 with public blockchain history

GET /api/v1/traceability/detail/:submissionId with authenticated token -> Receive 200 with detailed accreditation record -> GET /api/v1/traceability/detail/:submissionId without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response
GET /api/v1/traceability/search with no matching query -> Receive 200 with empty results set -> GET /api/v1/traceability/history/:submissionId for unknown submission -> Receive 404 history not found

features.name: Users Administration
features.description: Provides administrative access to list application users and inspect user accounts.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/users with authorized admin token -> Receive 200 with user list -> GET /api/v1/auth/me with the same token -> Receive 200 with current user profile for validation
GET /api/v1/users without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/v1/users with non-admin token -> Receive 403 forbidden

known_limitations.issue: Dependency bump (@google/generative-ai 0.1.3 -> 0.24.1) pulls undici 7.x which requires global File (Node 20+); server crashes on the default Node 18.19 in this environment.
known_limitations.impact: Backend fails to start on Node <20 with "ReferenceError. File is not defined"; must run on Node 20+.

known_limitations.issue: Scoring depends on external Google Generative AI quota (free tier 429s) and external Scholar services.
known_limitations.impact: Scoring/scholar sync endpoints may time out or rate-limit during tests.

known_limitations.issue: Many endpoints depend on Hyperledger Fabric Docker CLI and PostgreSQL state.
known_limitations.impact: Blockchain/certificate endpoints may fail if Fabric network containers are not running.
